'''Baltizaar''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the years before the Clone Wars. It was located in the [[Corthenia sector/Legends|Corthenia sector]].

==History==
{{Quote|I know something of that. Baltizaar's Senator petitioned for help in fending off attacks by the Bando Gora.|Palpatine|<ref name="DarthPlagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], prior to the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]], the planet was hit by attacks from the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]], a coven of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-worshipping assassins. After Baltizaar's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] pledged the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate's]] help, a Jedi task force was sent to the planet to deal with the cult, although military support was requested. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] criticized the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in a conversation with the Senator of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for this.<ref name="DarthPlagueis" />

The Jedi task force was subsequently decimated by the Bando Gora in a [[Battle of Baltizaar|battle]]. Most of the surviving Jedi returned to Coruscant. Dooku's former Padawan [[Komari Vosa]] was presumed dead. She was captured by the Bando Gora and tortured. She eventually killed her torturers and took control of the cult.<ref name="DarthPlagueis" />
